data.name: Nadeerah
data.gender_notes: Nadeerah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic word 'nadara' which means to guide, to show the way, or to make clear. This name is derived from the Quranic verse 'And he to whom We have given the Book and wisdom says, 'I have believed in it. And he will urge you [O Muhammad] to follow the right religion and to fear Allah.' [16:125]. The name Nadeerah carries the meaning “Guide, Sign” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nadeerah usually hope their child will grow to embody guide, sign and live with faith, good character and purpose.
